body.name: Exact pilot-localized multinomial inversion handle
body.construction: Split \(N\) observations deterministically into a pilot of size \(\lfloor N^{2/3}\rfloor\) and a main sample. Form an exact pilot product-simplex region with error budget \(\delta_N=\min\{\alpha/2,N^{-2}\}\). If one endpoint contrast is optimal throughout that region, invert its exact conditional product-multinomial distribution on the main sample; otherwise invert every retained contrast from \(\mathcal D_d^-\) and \(\mathcal D_d^+\) with a common Bonferroni allocation and map the intervals through the finite max-min formulas. Empty arms return the logical endpoint range.
